enhancement.description: Wheel of Names — an interactive app built in chat.
enhancement.prompt: Build me an app that lets me enter a list of names and spin a wheel to randomly pick one, with smooth animation and a clean result display.
enhancement.response:
Built it! It's a classic spin-the-wheel name picker. Here's what it does:
- You can add any number of names to the wheel, one at a time or all at once.
- Tap or click the spin button — the wheel spins with a smooth animation and gradually slows.
- When it stops, a name is selected and highlighted as the winner.
- You can remove names or reset the whole list anytime.
- The wheel's colors are random and cheerful, making it easy to tell names apart.
Just use the UI above to spin, or ask me to run it for you.
